title: Forge: verifyCertificateChain() removes trusted CA certificates with the same subject from the CA store…
description: A vulnerability in node-forge versions prior to 1.4.1 causes the CA store to lose trusted CA certificates with duplicate subject names during certificate chain verification. When verifying a chain, the function removes certificates from the CA store's internal list, leading to persistent denial of service for subsequent verifications involving those certificates. This affects applications that reuse a CA store containing multiple certificates sharing the same subject name. The issue is fixed in node-forge 1.4.1.
